cli.intro: Dejavu template engine — parse, render and check templates with the N-API engine

cmd.parse: Parse a template file into IR (usage: dejavu parse <file> [--out <file>] [--language <id>])
cmd.render: Render a template source or IR file (usage: dejavu render <file> [--ctx <file>] [--root <dir>])
cmd.check: Parse templates and report diagnostics (usage: dejavu check <path...> [--extensions <list>] [--root <dir>])
cmd.version: Print the CLI and binding contract versions

opt.out: Write IR to this file instead of stdout
opt.from-ir: Treat the input file as IR JSON
opt.ctx: JSON file with the render context
opt.root: Base directory for template ids (defaults to the template directory)

template.relative-without-from: relative reference `{ref}` requires a canonical caller id
template.relative-escape-root: relative reference `{ref}` escapes its catalog root
